sources.entry: FromScratch - Little app that you can use as a quick note taking or todo app.

summary.one_liner: FromScratch is a small Electron-based note-taking and todo app where the only interface is the text you type.
summary.what_it_does: The app saves notes automatically as you type, with no manual save step. It supports automatic indenting, note folding, and checkboxes for tracking TODO items. Keyboard shortcuts cover moving and deleting lines, search and regex search, find and replace, jumping to a line, zooming, and toggling light and dark themes. It replaces some common text syntax with symbols such as arrows. Notes are stored in a plain text file named content.txt, and a portable mode can keep config and text in a custom directory such as a USB stick or synced cloud folder.
use_cases: writing plain text notes with keyboard shortcuts
storing notes on a USB stick in portable mode
keeping notes in a synced cloud folder
how_to_run: git clone <repository URL> (the README leaves the URL blank)
fromscratch --portable (optional: run with data stored alongside the executable)
notable: Saves on the fly with no manual save needed
Note folding and checkbox TODO tracking in plain text
Portable mode stores config and notes in a chosen directory
Searchable with regular expressions and supports jump-to-line with relative offsets
Free and available for macOS, Windows and Linux
caveats: The README does not give a current download link; it refers to downloads for macOS, Windows and Linux without a URL.
The alt key menu toggle works on Windows only.
The cmd/ctrl+s shortcut does nothing, by design.
